board: Adafruit TCS34725 RGB Color Sensor with IR filter and White LED (#1334)
reason: Check passed on ESP32 and Pico (spec, wiring, design checks, breadboard, simulator, circuit board, footprint, LCSC). Driver follows the TCS3472 datasheet: command byte 0x80|reg (0xA0 auto-increment), PON then 2.4 ms wait then AEN, AVALID poll, one 8-byte little-endian read of C/R/G/B from 0xB4; the sim keys registers on the same command bytes (ID 0x92 = 0x44, STATUS 0x93 AVALID, counts at 0xB4-0xBB LE).
